metadata.mechanics: Participants may give gifts and offerings to the Target of the ritual in the form of Mind and Body. Participants may expend Mind or Body in counts of 2 up to a maximum of 40 total. For each 2 points spent the Target receives "Upsurge X Body/ Mind (where X equals half the total spent). The Performer of the Benediction may choose to spend 1 Resolve to increase the number of Targets to 2, but each Target is given 'gifts' separately.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession Saint. Must be Inducted to Tribes of the Seasons
metadata.locationOfUse: Consecrated Space dedicated to the Tribes of the Seasons
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: This Benediction is normally performed at the turning of a season to mark a change in leadership or as a celebration of a member of the faith in reaching a milestone in life (adoption, promotion, bonding, funerals, etc). This Benediction requires at least 30 minutes of Active Roleplay dedicated to growth, change, and advancement found within the season.
